name: Pet Simulator 99
tagline: Working Pet Simulator 99 codes for free diamonds, lucky boosts and rare pets.
description: Pet Simulator 99 is BIG Games' flagship Roblox title where players collect pets, hatch eggs and grind for diamonds. Codes are dropped with each major update and at engagement milestones (likes, visits, follower goals). Most codes reward diamonds, short-duration luck/boost buffs and occasionally exclusive pets — redeem them stacked before opening high-value eggs to maximise pulls.

redeemSteps.title: Launch Pet Simulator 99
redeemSteps.detail: Open Roblox and start any Pet Simulator 99 session.

redeemSteps.title: Open the Settings menu
redeemSteps.detail: Tap the Settings (gear) icon on the right side of the screen.

redeemSteps.title: Find the Codes box
redeemSteps.detail: Inside Settings, scroll to the Codes input box.

redeemSteps.title: Enter the code
redeemSteps.detail: Type or paste the code exactly. Pet Simulator 99 codes are case-sensitive and usually all lowercase.

redeemSteps.title: Hit Submit
redeemSteps.detail: Working codes deliver the reward instantly. If the box flashes red, the code is invalid or expired.

faq.question: How often does BIG Games release new codes?
faq.answer: Codes drop with every major Pet Simulator 99 update (roughly monthly) and at milestone events like 100M visits or like targets.

faq.question: Are Pet Simulator 99 codes one-time use?
faq.answer: Yes — each code can only be redeemed once per Roblox account.

faq.question: When should I use luck and boost codes?
faq.answer: Stack luck codes immediately before opening high-tier eggs, and use diamond boosts right before a long grinding session for maximum benefit.
